entity_id.description: An entity id: lowercase words joined by /. It carries no meaning and never changes.

record_id.description: A prefixed record id, e.g. src:renne-2013 or frame:paleomap/plate-201

ref.description: A reference: an entity id (with @phase or #key), local @phase or #key, a prefixed record id, or scheme:id

time_point.description: A decimal astronomical year; a number with CE, BCE, BP, ka, Ma, Ga, or kyr/Myr/Gyr from now; a calendar date or month, such as 15 March 44 BCE (Julian before 15 October 1582, Gregorian after, unless it names its calendar); a day by its Julian Day Number, JDN 584283; or, standing alone as a time or bounding the span of a relation, a day in a count of days, 9.12.11.5.18 Long Count (of the era before, for a day before its zero day)

oneOf.pattern: ^-?\d+(\.\d+)?(e[+-]?\d+)? (CE|BCE|BP|ka|Ma|Ga|kyr from now|Myr from now|Gyr from now)$
^\d+(\.\d+){4} Long Count( of the era before)?$

duration.description: Years, or a number with days, yr, kyr, Myr or Gyr

time.description: A point, an interval {lo, hi} (lo is the earlier; an end may be open or unknown), a normal distribution {mean, sd}, unknown, or another record's interval or edge {ref, edge, lag}

span_bound.description: A bound of a span: a time point, unknown, or the start or end of another record, as in "until his death"

valid.description: When a claim holds, or the span a relation held over: one time at which it held, or { lo, hi }, either left open, each a time point or the start or end of another record

point.description: A point, with the frame its coordinates were measured in

text.description: Text with its language: a map from language code to text

citation.description: A work, and where in it: page, figure, table, record. Machine extraction adds a short quote.

input.description: What a model or a generator reads from the world: a record (a field, a dataset, an entity or a claim of one), or every claim of one property or relation of one type, or every record of one kind; a property's claims may be narrowed to records of one kind

author.description: An account, or machine:<tool> for machine-made content

check_step.description: A step of checking a claim against its source (docs/STRUCTURE.md section 3.7): quoted, the quote found in the text the source was read in, by script; re-read, a second reader reached the same value on their own; audited, a person checked it as part of a sample. Acceptance is the claim's status.

how.description: What was done, and with what

confidence.description: A probability, or a calibrated word from the vocabulary

claim_common.description: What every claim, relations included, may carry

against.description: Works that deny the claim, each with where and a short quote: a court that refused it, a body that rejected it, a writer who says it is not so. A denial gives no other value, so it cannot be a competing claim; the claim's rank and its alternative say where it stands.

unsourced.description: Why the claim has no source: a claim with none says so

checked.description: How far it has been checked against its source, step by step
